svg.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: A tree node holds two independent 13-arm bandits, one per side, and a 13 by 13 table of child slots indexed by the pair of arms chosen. The leaf value v is added to side 1's chosen arm and 1 minus v to side 2's chosen arm.
svg.text: One tree node: two bandits and a 13 by 13 child table
Node { phase, visits, blind_visits, s1: Bandit, s2: Bandit, children: [u32; 169] }
A Bandit is up to 13 arms of { action, visits, total_score }, one arm per legal action byte.
In each strip the small number is the arm index and the bold number is that arm's action byte.
n = visits and Σ = total_score are per arm; the exploration formula scores an arm by its mean q = Σ / n.
Each side picks from its own statistics; the pair names the child. Values accumulate in f64.
